scope.split: existing train only; no new data or synthetic/real val/test read
scope.metric: normalized MSE; four train windows at512/2048; not RMSE, statistical uncertainty or real project trajectory risk
scope.operation: Existing JSON, byte hashes and36 CPU-only checkpoint deserializations after expected-SHA verification; no project model execution, GPU allocation, tests, updates or predictions.

native_cost.note: Wall and JobCPU separately; do not sum or add per-model filesystem intervals as extra native cost.

timestamp_estimate_convention.source: Filesystem training.pt last-write time; wall-clock difference, not instrumented GPU timing or per-stage native CPU.
timestamp_estimate_convention.0_to512: Includes training updates1..512 and checkpoint publication work aftercheckpoint0. Excludes evaluation512, which runs after checkpoint512.
timestamp_estimate_convention.512_to2048: Includes evaluation512, model reconstruction/shared restore, updates513..2048 and final checkpoint publication. Excludes evaluation2048.
timestamp_estimate_convention.after2048: Checkpoint2048 to metrics2048 publication approximates final two-step evaluation plus JSON publication; excludes later models and global freeze validation.
timestamp_estimate_convention.caveat: File times can be affected by host clock or file copy. These are elapsed estimates only, not pure training speed benchmarks.

optimization_warning: Actual fit losses compare within the same train window and minibatch stream. Equal2048 updates do not imply equal integration work or convergence. Longer future uses4x batchedRK4 steps. Late loss ratios are descriptive, not convergence certificates.

readonly_extraction_accounting.note: Separate factual-extraction process. Observed counters before JSON publication, not final OS exit counters; do not conflate with formal native job costs.
